description: The completed legacy (improvement-round) finalization and its cycle, copied read-only from the live database on 2026-09-25 (R-B10). It must stay readable and renderable after the legacy controller branches are removed.

rounds.instructions: Focus on plan completeness and downstream contract conpliance.
Focus on overcomplication and/or over engineering.

finalization.instructions: Ensure all work matches the plan intent within reason. No invariants should be violated. If simplifications are possible that don’t change the outcome please make them.
finalization.reason: Promoted to main by explicit operator approval.

finding.title: Wait-resume predicate written twice inside one recovery invariant check
finding.explanation: In the same validation function the predicate 'this resolution resumes the run' is computed twice, once as a match at lines 843-851 (Children|Signal|Control => true, Deadline => spec.deadline().policy == ResumeWithTimeout, _ => false) and again as chained matches! at lines 872-880 for the records loop. I checked both copies are equivalent today, but two spellings of one recovery-correctness rule in a branch-new file invite silent divergence when a WaitResolutionKind variant or timeout policy is added. Behaviour-neutral polish.
finding.recommendation: Add a private fn resumes(record: &WaitRecord) -> bool (or a method on the record) and call it from both sites. No wire, fixture or snapshot bytes change.

deferredNits.reason: These are relatively minor and the body of finalization stands for itself. Independent review authorized.

finding.title: DataRef canonical sub-encoding duplicated verbatim between the disposition and signal canonical encoders
finding.explanation: Encoder::data in disposition_digest.rs (lines 19-35) and the inline closure in CanonicalSignalV1::new in continuation/signal_canonical.rs (lines 47-62) emit the identical tagged encoding of DataRef (tag 0: content_type option, bytes, hash; tag 1: scheme, locator, hash, size option, content_type option), 14 duplicated lines of canonical-format code in two branch-new files. The shared Encoder already lives in canonical.rs with pub(crate) helpers, so the duplication is unnecessary; the two formats are separately versioned and covered by golden vectors, so sharing the helper changes no bytes. Behaviour-neutral polish.
finding.recommendation: Move fn data(&mut self, &DataRef) onto Encoder in crates/actionqueue-core/src/canonical.rs as pub(crate) and call e.data(p) from signal_canonical.rs. The existing signal-v1 and disposition vectors in the conformance package prove byte identity.

finding.title: Daemon and config polish: triple serialization of inspection responses, allowlist validated through a throwaway telemetry object with a misleading error code, redundant disclosure term, repeated platform handler prologue
finding.explanation: (a) api.rs value() (line 200) serializes every inspection response to Vec<u8> for the 2 MiB size check, deserializes it back into serde_json::Value, and Json(v) serializes it a third time; the bytes could be returned directly. (b) daemon config.rs validate() (line 193) validates signal_metric_allowlist by constructing QueueTelemetry::default() (an Arc<Mutex<Observations>>), calling set_signal_allowlist and discarding it, and reports failure as ConfigErrorCode::InvalidMetricsBind, which names a different field; the pure check in storage mutation/telemetry.rs lines 42-46 is what is wanted. (c) runtime inspection.rs Inspector::new (line 74) computes disclose: request_references && policy.allow_references after line 70 already returned Unauthorized whenever request_references && !policy.allow_references, so the second term is dead. (d) http/platform.rs create_tenant, assign_role, grant_capability and append_ledger_entry (lines 34-180) repeat the same authority-None check, lock match, latest_sequence()+1, clock.now(), execute_host_mutation and Ok/Err mapping; the shape is inherited from main but the branch rewrote all four identically. All branch-introduced or branch-rewritten; behaviour-neutral.
finding.recommendation: Optional polish: return the checked Vec<u8> with an application/json content type from value(); expose a pure telemetry::validate_signal_allowlist(&BTreeSet<(String,String)>) used by both DaemonConfig::validate and set_signal_allowlist, and report it under a dedicated ConfigErrorCode (or at least not InvalidMetricsBind); simplify Inspector::new to disclose: request_references; factor one host_mutation(state, host, build_command, ok_response) helper for the four platform handlers.
